title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Rewarding effort
hook: Do you give out a game ball? Who gets it?
intro: The player with the big hit gets the ball again.
The kid who hustled on every play gets nothing.
statement: What you reward is what kids learn to value.
q1: Do you give an award for effort each game —
q2: or skip awards so no one feels left out?
q3: Who on your team works hardest without being noticed?
t1: Every team is different. But effort grows
t2: when it gets noticed out loud.
cta: Coaches — do you give out awards?
ctaLines: Hustle award. Team picks. No awards.
ctaPrompt: Share your award habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you give out a game ball? Who gets it?
The player with the big hit gets the ball again. The kid who hustled on every play gets nothing.
What you reward is what kids learn to value.
An effort award or no awards at all. There is no single right way.
Do you give out awards? Share your habit in the comments.
